description.en: Studio is a playful portfolio for students, illustrators, and junior creatives: introduce yourself and your skills, filter case studies by type, show side projects, and receive messages through a validated contact form.
description.id: Studio adalah portofolio ceria untuk pelajar, ilustrator, dan kreatif junior: perkenalkan diri dan keahlian, saring studi kasus per jenis, pamerkan proyek sampingan, dan terima pesan lewat form kontak yang tervalidasi.
